derived_not_transmitted.flat: field[0] == 0 within upstream exact position convention
derived_not_transmitted.position_phase: derive from field[2] and fixed max-holding protocol if needed
derived_not_transmitted.simple_mark_to_market_unrealized_directi: derive from sign(field[0]) and exp(field[1])-1; exact PnL scaling depends on the account physics contract

fields.name: signed_exposure_fraction_of_contract_cap
fields.range: unclipped real; normal contract region approximately [-1,1]
fields.reason: jointly preserves direction and normalized size without a redundant direction field
fields.semantic: Signed current gross exposure as fraction of the fixed contract gross-leverage cap. Sign encodes short(-)/flat(0)/long(+); magnitude encodes size.

fields.name: entry_price_log_ratio
fields.reason: distinguishes profitable/underwater inventory without absolute price
fields.semantic: Scale-free current price relative to entry/cost basis.
fields.valid_when: non-flat position and current_price>0 and entry_price>0

fields.name: remaining_holding_fraction
fields.reason: directly exposes forced-exit proximity; normalized duration is redundant
fields.semantic: Fraction of max-holding horizon remaining. Negative values preserve overdue-contract severity.

fields.name: current_drawdown_fraction
fields.reason: path-dependent risk state not recoverable from current market/position

fields.name: risk_budget_remaining_fraction
fields.reason: exposes independent risk headroom; negative value can represent exhausted/violated budget
fields.semantic: Remaining externally authoritative risk budget as a fraction of its capacity.

fields.name: margin_utilization_fraction
fields.reason: exposes constraint headroom not guaranteed to be derivable from gross exposure
fields.semantic: Current margin usage as fraction of available margin capacity.

revision_triggers: max-holding contract varies across accounts in a way whose absolute horizon matters
gross-leverage cap varies across accounts and the absolute cap itself is decision-relevant
PnL contains non-derivable funding/fee/option effects that cannot be reconstructed from transmitted state plus fixed account physics
portfolio becomes multi-asset and one scalar signed exposure is no longer sufficient
margin/risk-budget semantics are not authoritative or not synchronized to the packet timestamp
